Merge.description: Select another compatible base Pillar, then Attune the hybrid Pillar to either source element.

Scorch.description: When played, deal {strength} damage to any player or card with HP.

Fury.description: After this creature attacks the opponent, it permanently gains +{strength} ATK.

Burn.description: When this creature attacks the opponent, add {strength} Burn to that player. Burn stacks and deals its total damage at the end of the afflicted card or player's turn.

Strike.description: This turn, attack a random opposing creature if one is present; otherwise attack the opponent.

Last Spark.description: When this creature is destroyed, deal {strength} damage to the opponent.

Freeze.description: Pay this ability's cost and choose one opposing card. It cannot attack or activate abilities during its next {strength} turn(s).

Bounce.description: When played, return up to {strength} opposing creatures from the battlefield to their owner's hand.

Shell.description: Reduce combat damage dealt to this creature by {strength}, to a minimum of 0.

Provoke.description: During opposing combat, this creature draws up to {strength} attackers away from its controller.

Growth.description: At the start of your turn, gain +{strength} ATK and +{strength} maximum and current HP.

Scald.description: When this card attacks, deal {strength} additional damage to its target.

Regeneration.description: At turn start, restore player and card HP.

Flame Strike.description: When attacking a card, deal {strength} additional damage.

Fireball.description: Deal {strength} damage to any player or card with HP.

Fire Rain.description: Deal {strength} damage to every enemy creature and structure.

Ember Offering.description: Sacrifice a friendly creature and gain {strength} Fire mana.

Cinder Ward.description: For 3 opposing combat phases, creatures that attack you take {strength} damage.

Ashen Bargain.description: Sacrifice a friendly creature and draw {strength} cards.

Berserker Draught.description: Give any card with HP +{strength} ATK and -3 HP.

Regrowth.description: Restore {strength} HP to a friendly card.

Ignite.description: Add {strength} Burn to any player or card with HP.

Grant Burn.description: Give a target creature Burn {strength}. Multiple grants stack and remain while that creature stays in play.

Spawn Sapling.description: Create a 1/1 Sapling in a random empty battlefield position.

Nurture.description: At the start of your turn, give another highest-value friendly creature +{strength} ATK and +{strength} HP.

Elf Chorus.description: Other friendly Elves gain +{strength} ATK while this card remains in play.

Sprout.description: At the start of your turn, create {strength} 1/1 Sapling(s).

Pack Growth.description: This creature gains +{strength}/+{strength} for each other friendly creature sharing at least one subtype with it.

Grove Blessing.description: When played, give every friendly creature +{strength} maximum and current HP.

Elder Call.description: When played, create a 2/2 Elder Sapling in a random empty battlefield position.

Living Grove.description: This creature gains +{strength}/+{strength} for each other friendly creature.

Clock.description: At the end of this creature's controller's turn, reduce Clock by 1. At 0, transform it into a Sea Drake.

Frozen Incubation.description: If this Egg would be Frozen, reduce its Clock by the Freeze duration instead. It does not become Frozen.

Clear the Tide.description: Remove all Burn from you and your cards, then restore {strength} player HP.

Sea Nursery.description: Create {strength} Sea Eggs in random empty friendly battlefield positions.

Deep Freeze.description: Choose up to 3 creatures. Freeze each for {strength} turns; Sea Eggs reduce Clock instead.

Mass Incubation.description: Create {strength} Sea Eggs in random empty friendly battlefield positions.

Blizzard.description: Freeze every creature on both battlefields for {strength} turns. Sea Eggs reduce Clock instead.

First Sprout.description: Add {strength} Seed Elves to your hand.

Grove Muster.description: Create {strength} 2/2 Elder Saplings in random empty friendly battlefield positions.

Protective Canopy.description: Choose up to 3 friendly creatures. Give each Shell {strength} for 2 turns.

Nurturing Touch.description: Give a friendly creature +{strength} ATK and +{strength} maximum and current HP permanently.

Thorn Volley.description: Deal damage to any target equal to the number of friendly creatures you control.

Spore Cloud.description: Create {strength} Spores on the opponent's battlefield. At that side's end turn, each Spore permanently gives a random friendly unit -1 ATK.

Spore Attrition.description: At the end of your turn, permanently give a random friendly unit -{strength} ATK.

Elf Chorus Spell.description: Give every friendly Elf +{strength} ATK permanently.

Verdant Surge.description: Create 3 Seed Elves, then give every friendly creature +1 maximum and current HP permanently.

Canopy of Ages.description: Give every friendly creature Shell 2 for 2 turns and restore 5 player HP.

Forest Armada.description: Create 4 Seed Elves. If you then control at least 6 creatures, give every friendly creature +1 ATK permanently.

Wildheart Strike.description: Deal damage to any target equal to twice the number of friendly creatures you control.

Worldroot Ascension.description: Give every friendly creature +3 ATK and +3 maximum and current HP permanently, then create 4 Seed Elves.
